name: MBZP
summary: A stimulant drug which is a derivative of BZP.

pharmacology.text: It animals, it has adrenergic blocking activity.

uses.text: MBZP has been sold as an ingredient in legal recreational drugs known as "party pills", initially in New Zealand and subsequently in other countries around the world. It is not approved for any medical use but is legally available as a research chemical.

sideEffects.text: The effects of MBZP are very similar to those of benzylpiperazine (BZP), but the stimulant effect is slightly weaker and it seems to have less of a tendency to cause negative side effects such as headaches and nausea.
